slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
第1383章圣人气息，惊世大战
无数修士惊恐，这样恐怖的神通很多修士还是第一次遇到。
“这是紫天一的护道者，他从哪里找来如此恐怖的三尊修士。”
“这就是半步合道的修为吗，我炼虚八重天，一个照面差点被干掉，还好他们针对的不是本座。”
“普通的半步合道怎么会有此等修为和神通，这样的法力和神通，放在半步合道都是顶尖的。”
“那二十五尊是传说中的金乌吗，这是何种神通，本座怎么感觉这是二十五尊恐怖无比的半步合道无上妖皇。”
不仅是普通修士，几尊炼虚大圆满和半步合道修士脸色骇然，其中几尊，被灭世金乌直接从虚空之中击落，受了不小的伤。
一尊半步合道修士惊悚：“他们怎么会如此恐怖？”
同等修为，他们在这三人面前竟然感觉相差一个大境界一般。
另外一尊半步合道修士同样震惊：“合道不出，这三人是最顶级的大修士。”
一尊炼虚大圆满修士问道：“几位道友，你们难道就这样看着大道本源失去，失去合道机会？这可是我等唯一机会。
在其他地方，我等散修怎么可能有资格获得大道本源，大道本源都掌握在那些仙门手中。”
散修是强大，可是再强在仙门面前根本算不得什么，仙门都有强大的大能者，无法想象的底蕴，和仙门抢夺资源，都没有一个好下场的。
他们的修为在紫云星是强，可是放在灵界只能算中等，想要染指高等级资源还没有这种资格。
大道本源这样的至宝，在外界，只要出现立刻被仙门不惜一切代价收走。
几人脸上凶光闪烁，但是看着天上三尊强大的修士，一时间不敢轻举妄动。
紫天一寻找的人，绝对不会看走眼，能够让这些炼虚大圆满和半步合道都不敢轻易动手。
一尊半步合道修士无奈：“没有办法，这三人太强了，我等不是对手。”
炼虚大圆满修士说道：“我这里有一宝物，可以破掉三人的防御，大道本源在下不需要，我要那天戈。”
他指着天戈，那至少是一尊中品道器，很可能是上品道器。

一尊半步合道冷哼：“道友好大的胃口。”
炼虚大圆满不畏惧：“不是在下胃口大，而是在下带着圣人法旨，一定要将这里的宝物带出去。”
圣人法旨？
几人震惊，他们已经明白了这炼虚大圆满修士的身份，这是合道圣人布置的棋子。
而且恐怕不止此人，在天虚之中还有其他圣人棋子，紫云星庞大无比，合道圣人也有三十余尊，只是几乎不会插手紫云星上的事情。
他们常年闭关苦修。
这次一尊合道后期的圣墓，让他们坐不住了。
又是一尊炼虚大圆满修士走了出来：“紫云仙城，想要那道卷。”
两人既然走出来，手中定然有着合道圣人的宝物。
五尊炼虚大圆满，三尊半步合道修士同意合作。
其中一人站了出来，盯着三道神威，踏上虚空，他脸色傲然，对着三人说道：“本座乃是天柱山青芜圣人座下，奉圣人法旨。
圣墓中的宝物尽归天柱山，到时候圣人自会进行安排。”
天柱山，这是周围除了紫云仙城之外最强的仙门势力了，门内有合道圣人坐镇。

凌莫淡然开口：“什么青芜圣人，本座没有听说过。”

Chapter 1383: Saint’s Breath, Shocking Battle
Countless monks were frightened. This was the first time for many monks to encounter such terrifying supernatural powers.
"This is Zi Tianyi's protector. Where did he find such three terrifying monks?"
"Is this the cultivation level of half-step Hedao? I was practicing in the eighth level of the virtual world, and I was almost killed in one encounter. Fortunately, they were not targeting me."
"How can an ordinary Half-step Hedao have such cultivation and magical powers? Such magical power and magical powers are top-notch even in Half-step Hedao."
"Are those twenty-five legendary Golden Crows? What kind of magical power are they? Why do I feel that these are twenty-five terrifying half-step supreme demon kings?"
Not only the ordinary monks, but also the several Void Refining Dzogchen and Half-Step Hedao monks looked horrified. Several of them were shot down from the void by the World-Destroying Golden Crow and suffered considerable injuries.
A half-step Hedao monk was horrified: "How could they be so terrifying?"
With the same level of cultivation, they actually felt that they were in a huge level of difference in front of these three people.
Another half-step Hedao monk was equally shocked: "If you can't get out of Hedao, these three are the top monks."
A cultivator of the Dzogchen Refining Void asked: "Fellow Taoists, are you just watching the origin of the Tao disappear and lose the opportunity to join the Tao? This is the only chance for us.
In other places, how can we and other casual cultivators be qualified to obtain the origin of the avenue? The origin of the avenue is in the hands of those immortal sects. "
Rogue cultivators are powerful, but no matter how strong they are in front of the Immortal Sect, it is nothing. The Immortal Sect all has powerful people with unimaginable background, and they will compete with the Immortal Sect for resources, and there will be no good end.
Their cultivation level is strong in Ziyun Star, but can only be considered average in the spiritual world. They do not have the qualifications to get access to high-level resources.
A treasure like the Origin of the Great Dao, in the outside world, will be taken away by the Immortal Sect at all costs as soon as it appears.
Several people's faces flashed with ferocious light, but looking at the three powerful monks in the sky, they did not dare to act rashly for a while.
The person Zi Tianyi is looking for will never make mistakes, and can make these Lianxu Dzogchen and Half-step Hedao not dare to attack easily.
A half-step Hedao monk said helplessly: "There is no way, these three people are too strong, and we are no match for them."
The monk of Lianxu Dzogchen said: "I have a treasure here that can break the defense of three people. I don't need it at the source of the avenue. I want that day's Ge."
He pointed at Tian Ge, which was at least a middle-grade Taoist artifact, and probably a high-grade Taoist artifact.
Yi Zun half-stepped and snorted coldly: "Taoist friend has a big appetite."
Lianxu Dzogchen is not afraid: "It's not because I have a big appetite, but because I have the decree of the saint, I must take the treasures here out."
The decree of the saint?
Several people were shocked. They already understood the identity of this monk of Lianxu Dzogchen. This was a chess piece arranged by the saint of Hedao.
And I'm afraid it's not just this person, there are other saint chess pieces in Tianxu. Ziyun Star is huge, and there are more than thirty Hedao Saints, but they almost never interfere in the affairs of Ziyun Star.
They spend many years in seclusion and practice ascetic practices.
This time, a holy tomb from the late Hedao period made them unable to sit still.
Another cultivator of the Great Perfection of Refining the Void came out: "Ziyun Immortal City, I want that scroll."
Since the two of them came out, they must have the treasure of the Hedao Saint in their hands.
The five monks achieved perfection in refining the void, and the three half-step monks agreed to cooperate.
One of them stood up, stared at the three divine powers, and stepped into the void. He looked proud and said to the three of them: "This seat is under the seat of Saint Qingwu in Tianzhu Mountain, and I follow the decree of the Saint.
All the treasures in the Holy Tomb will be returned to Tianzhu Mountain, and the Saint will make arrangements when the time comes. "
Tianzhu Mountain, this is the strongest immortal sect force in the surrounding area besides Ziyun Immortal City, and there is a Hedao Saint sitting in the sect.

Ling Mo said calmly: "I have never heard of Qingwu Saint."
